facts.fact: Deputy Prime Minister Thulisile Dladla said the National Dynamic Social Registry (Imbeleko) is being built, with Lubombo household data collection scheduled for 2026-10-12 to 2026-11-27 after the Shiselweni enumeration of June to July 2025.

The Observer reports Shiselweni Region pilot results of the National Dynamic Social Registry (Imbeleko), covering 47,766 households with 44,683 registered and ready for targeting, which government intends to use to target social protection.

Social Registry official Nosizo Mtfupha said the Shiselweni pilot registered 44,683 of 47,766 households in the Social Registry database, and the World Bank contributed US$2.5 million (about E42.5 million) to the programme.

facts.fact: The article says data collection for the National Dynamic Social Registry has already commenced in the Shiselweni Region, with the Deputy Prime Minister's Office receiving WFP equipment worth over E850,000 for the rollout.

The Deputy Prime Minister said Imbeleko, the National Dynamic Social Registry, is being rolled out, with enumerators trained in March 2025 and households registered across Shiselweni in June-July 2025 in a pilot phase.

Eswatini's project coordinator Ncamiso Nkambule reported that field data collection for the National Dynamic Social Registry, run through the Deputy Prime Minister's Office, has commenced, to be used to select beneficiaries of the World Bank-financed EYEOP.
The Eswatini Observer reports the ICT ministry listed the social registry among 13 online services restored in October 2026.
